tools.name: koishi_call
tools.description: Call any OneBot v11 action on the dialed implementation (NapCat-style forward WebSocket; this world speaks no Koishi protocol). Read-only actions run immediately. Write actions run only on a turn with an identified inbound sender (a turn without an inbound message is refused, 60004) and follow writePolicy (default: confirm=true required). Credential actions get_cookies/get_csrf_token/get_credentials are not served (10002).

action.description: v11 action name, e.g. send_group_msg or get_group_info.

confirm.description: Set true to execute a write action under the confirm policy.

summary.zh: 调用 v11 action（拨 NapCat 类正向 WS，非 Koishi 协议）；只读直接执行，写动作要求本轮有实证发起方（缺入站记录回 60004）并按策略需 confirm=true；凭证动作不进桥（10002）。
summary.en: Call a v11 action over the dialed v11 implementation (NapCat-style forward WS, not the Koishi protocol); reads run immediately, writes need an identified inbound sender this turn (60004 without one) and follow the write policy; credential actions are not served (10002).

tools.name: koishi_actions
tools.description: Look up the OneBot v11 action catalog with implementation selection. No args lists categories, coverage and the detected implementation (extensions whitelist is a guessed starting value: empty, display-only); query searches name/summary; name returns one entry.

name.description: Return the catalog entry for this action.

summary.zh: 查 OneBot v11 动作目录、分类、覆盖数与实现识别结果。
summary.en: Look up the OneBot v11 action catalog, categories, coverage and implementation detection.

tools.name: koishi_events
tools.description: Read archived OneBot v11 events by kind/time. kind supports * globs (e.g. notice/*).

kind.description: Event kind or glob: message/group, notice/group_recall, meta_event/*.

summary.zh: 按类型和时间查已归档的 OneBot v11 事件。
summary.en: Read archived OneBot v11 events by kind and time.

tools.name: koishi_status
tools.description: Bridge connection, account, detected implementation, v11 coverage and current write policy.

summary.zh: 看桥连接、账号、识别出的实现、v11 覆盖面与写策略。
summary.en: Show bridge connection, account, detected implementation, v11 coverage and write policy.

description.zh: 一条 QQ 消息；正文是一行可读文本，meta.raw 是原始 v11 事件（ID 为 v11 原生数字，不做 Koishi 字符串化）。
description.en: A QQ message; text is one readable line, meta.raw is the original v11 event (native numeric IDs, no Koishi stringification).

description.zh: OneBot v11 notice / meta_event；正文是一行摘要，meta.raw 是原始事件。
description.en: An OneBot v11 notice or meta_event; text is a compact line, meta.raw is the original event.

description.zh: OneBot v11 request（加好友 / 加群）；meta.raw 是原始事件。
description.en: An OneBot v11 request (friend / group); meta.raw is the original event.

description.zh: 桥连接建立或断开（对端是 v11 实现端，非 Koishi 服务端）。
description.en: Bridge connected or disconnected (peer is a v11 implementation, not a Koishi server).
